narrative: Two same-week advisories are the forcing function behind the zero-trust-default-on thesis (Jun 27): Langflow's IDOR (CVSS 9.9) proves the orchestration plane ships without deny-by-default per-tenant authorization, and AutoGPT's SSRF bypass (CVE-2026-56663, CVSS 8.5) proves the execution plane ships without egress-hardened tool calls. A fetch-arbitrary-URL block and an opaque-ID flow are SSRF and cross-tenant surfaces unless gated by default.
remaining_gap: Still missing a major platform shipping deny-by-default authorization and/or SSRF-hardened egress allowlisting in a named release; today gives motivating CVEs, not a default-posture shipment.
